'''Sandra Collins''' (born 16 July 1970) is an Irish mathematician and leading academic librarian, who is the university librarian of [[University College Dublin]], Ireland's largest university, since 2022. She was director of the [[National Library of Ireland]] from 2015.

==Career==
Collins attended [[University College Dublin]], graduating with a [[Bachelor of Science|BSc]] in Mathematics and Mathematical Physics in 1991, and receiving a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in Nonlinear Fluid Dynamics in 1996.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last= |date=2015-05-25 |title=National Library announces appointment of new Director |url=http://www.nli.ie/en/list/latest-news.aspx?article=882c677f-7ed5-47ce-af2b-365aab228f0b |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=National Library of ireland |language=en}}</ref>

She worked as a lecturer in mathematics at [[Dublin City University]], with [[Ericsson]], and as director of the Digital Repository of Ireland at the [[Royal Irish Academy]]. 

She was appointed director of the National Library of Ireland in 2015, for a five-year term,<ref name=":0" /> and agreed a second term from 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-culture-communications-and-sport/press-releases/minister-martin-announces-the-re-appointment-of-dr-sandra-collins-as-director-of-the-national-library-of-ireland/|title=Minister Martin announces the re-appointment of Dr. Sandra Collins as Director of the National Library of Ireland|publisher=Government of Ireland, Department of Culture, Communications and Sport|date=18 August 2020|access-date=2025-07-10}}</ref>  She has been the university librarian at University College Dublin since 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-20 |title=UCD appoints Dr Sandra Collins as Librarian |url=https://www.ucd.ie/newsandopinion/news/2021/december/20/ucdappointsdrsandracollinsaslibrarian/ |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=University College Dublin}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Collins received three Ireland eGovernment awards for collaborative digital cultural projects: 'Promoting Ireland Overseas', 'Open Source', and 'Overall Winner'.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-01-30 |title=DRI sweeps the eGovernment Awards! |url=https://www.dri.ie/dri-sweeps-egovernment-awards |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=Digital Repository Ireland}}</ref> She received the UCD Alumni Award in Research, Innovation and Impact in 2020.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sandra Collins: UCD Alumni Award in Research, Innovation and Impact |url=https://alumni.ucd.ie/awards/awardee/sandra-collins/#:~:text=UCD%20Alumni%20Award%20in%20Research%2C%20Innovation%20and%20Impact&text=She%20was%20named%20by%20Silicon,from%20mathematics%20to%20cultural%20heritage |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=UCD Alumni}}</ref>
